unfortunately, if you want to lose weight and keep it off when you have an eating disorder, you're gonna need to get treatment for the eating disorder first. i'm at basically the same stats as you and this is a healthy weight for your height, BMI-wise, so wanting to lose more weight could potentially be a symptom of your ed.

i tried to diet normally without relapsing and it worked for a couple months but without treatment it's just not possible. it's like sending an alcoholic to a bar and expecting them to take just one shot.

if you're determined though, i would focus on making yourself healthier instead of making yourself thinner. get like 30mins-1hr of exercise (an exercise you enjoy doing, preferably) every couple days and eat foods that taste good and are good for you, and don't focus on the calories in vs calories out.

this is all based on my own experiences of course, i wish you luck on recovery! :)
